name: guard_comment_suppresses_everything
notes: D3 guard order: the comment guard runs first and returns an empty exclusive list, so nothing (not even the command fallback) is offered inside a `;` comment.

name: guard_comment_ignores_semicolon_inside_single_quotes
notes: D2 regression: is_in_comment is quote-aware, so the `;` inside '…' does NOT start a comment; the cascade reaches the command fallback (37 = COMMAND_COMPLETIONS len).

name: guard_key_signature_block
notes: D3: cursor inside an unterminated `_{…}` key-signature block — is_in_key_sig(line, cursor) is true, so the guard fires before any provider.

name: guard_leading_track_selector_region
notes: D3: cursor at character 2 == selector.end for `AB` (spans A[0,1) B[1,2)); TS predicate is `column <= selector.end + 1` (1-based) i.e. `character <= end` (0-based).

name: guard_note_suppression_bare_note
notes: D3: whitespace-bounded token `c` matches isNoteOrRestToken, so the `C<ticks>` command must not surface. Arpeggio is off by default (suite default), so nothing takes over.

name: guard_note_suppression_dotted
notes: D3: `c8.` is a note token (duration + dot).

name: guard_note_suppression_colon_length
notes: D3: `c:12` (explicit tick length) is a note token.

name: guard_note_suppression_octave_prefixed
notes: D3: `>c` is not a whitespace-bounded note token, but the broader suffix check (endsAtNoteLike, `[<>]*[a-h]…$`) catches it.

name: guard_rest_suppression
notes: D3: `r4` matches the rest branch of isNoteOrRestToken.

name: guard_hash_prefix_bail
notes: Cascade bail: line's first non-ws char is `#` but no meta-keyword/meta-value context matches (`#title` takes free text) — exclusive empty, no command fallback.

name: guard_at_prefix_bail
notes: Cascade bail: line starts with `@` but no instrument-type / @meta / fm / pcm context matches — exclusive empty.
